articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video with a 1-million-token context window. Benchmarks show a significant leap in long-horizon planning tasks and complex code generation, narrowing the gap between LLM outputs and expert-level software engineering. The model also introduces persistent memory across sessions via a new stateful API endpoint.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which set new records on ScienceBench and MathOlympiad datasets, demonstrating the ability to propose novel hypotheses in materials science that were subsequently validated in the lab. The model leverages a mixture-of-experts architecture scaled to over 3 trillion parameters with improved inference efficiency. Researchers highlighted its potential to accelerate drug discovery and climate modeling pipelines.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Pilot Deployment at Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla has begun deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots at Amazon and DHL fulfillment centers in a paid pilot program, marking the first commercial use outside Tesla's own factories. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and can autonomously learn new pick-and-place tasks via demonstration within minutes. Early reports indicate a 40% throughput improvement over the Gen 2 prototypes shown earlier this year.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Modular Tool Swapping
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform, featuring a modular end-effector system that allows the humanoid to swap between grippers, drills, and inspection tools in under 30 seconds. The system is targeting construction and energy infrastructure inspection markets, with Hyundai committing to deploy 500 units across its shipbuilding operations by mid-2027. The new platform runs on an on-board foundation model for real-time scene understanding and task planning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI 2.0 Framework with Formal Verification Guarantees
articles.summary: Anthropic published a major update to its Constitutional AI alignment methodology, incorporating formal verification techniques borrowed from hardware design to mathematically prove certain safety properties of model outputs. The framework enables developers to specify invariant safety constraints that the model is guaranteed not to violate within defined operational domains. The approach has drawn significant interest from regulated industries including healthcare and aviation seeking auditable AI safety assurances.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around transistor architecture at its Kaohsiung fab. The node delivers a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over N2, and is expected to be the foundation for NVIDIA's next-generation Blackwell Ultra GPUs and AMD's MI450 accelerators shipping in early 2027. The ramp is seen as critical for meeting surging global demand for AI training and inference compute.

articles.title: Meta Demonstrates Orion AR Glasses with Real-Time Neural Interface Typing at 120 WPM
articles.summary: Meta showcased an updated version of its Orion augmented reality glasses integrated with a wrist-based EMG neural interface that enables text input at 120 words per minute without any physical keyboard. The system uses a lightweight on-device transformer model to decode motor neuron signals with 97% accuracy. Meta announced a limited developer edition shipping in Q1 2027, positioning the device as a laptop replacement for knowledge workers.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office has initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act's provisions for general-purpose AI models, targeting OpenAI, Google, and Mistral's operations in Europe. Auditors are examining training data documentation, systemic risk assessments, and energy consumption reporting as required under the Act's transparency obligations. The enforcement actions are being closely watched as a bellwether for how the world's most comprehensive AI regulation will function in practice.
